#TBNWFMinManila
#TheBoyNextWorld
#BossNoeul #BoNoh 

UPDATED GUIDE FOR INTERFANS:

Please register your arrival at https://t.co/iVBU9NhyPx because immigration will know if you didn’t fill it out. If you forget, don’t worry, you can still do it in the airport (using airport wifi) but it will take some time. You will also need the qr code sent in the app or email to be able to exit customs.

Please use Grab app only. Do not use ordinary taxis. The rest of our public transportation is too complicated to explain for foreigners.

There are ATMs in the airport and they accept most international cards. You can also get sim cards if you do not have roaming. The most popular networks are Smart and Globe.

Please note the airport terminal you will be arriving and leaving from to have the correct Grab pin. It will be difficult to transfer to the correct terminal because while there is a shuttle bus, they never leave on schedule and always pass through traffic.

Please watch your belongings in crowded areas. Most urban places are safe, but please take proper precautions when necessary.

For Filipino food recommendations, I suggest Manam for traditional, Jollibee or Mang Inasal for fastfood, or Wildflour for upscale brunch. All of these restaurants are within walking distance from Music Museum.

If you have enough time, you can tour Intramuros, Luneta Park, and the National Museum. Bonus, you can eat at the same traditional lunch buffet in Barbara’s where Boss danced the tinikling.

If there’s anything here I haven’t covered, please feel free to dm me.

Welcome to Manila! 🇵🇭
